items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, really? So, uh, Dundee Taylor, it used to be on the farm.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. It was playing there. Oh, real Eagle Hall.
Oh, really? So, uh, Dundee Taylor, it used to be on the farm.

Uh-huh. So, I stopped in there, and they got to recess with them, and they, I called them down to get a drink. They come along and got a drink, and a bunch of women's in there and men. All the drinks for the house. So, when I bought the drinks for the house, well, I bought the drinks with me. Paid for the walk out, and, uh, I could get drink, drink, and have people's milk. All the way down, it was. So, Buckland had a play. So, I went down there after crossing out. Went down there to him. He, uh, told him I wanted…
